items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: she's my grandmother, but I always called her Mammy

ctx.x: Why did you hate to see her? Did it look bad or --

Yes. You know, and sometime I'd say, well, you know, you have to be careful how you talk to the old folks sometime. I said -- I used to call her -- she's my grandmother, but I always called her Mammy, you know, I called her Mammy, because I could get more out of her by calling her Mammy, you know. If I called her Grandmother,
that's all right for the girls to call her Grandmother, but she didn't want me to call her Grandmother, you know, and you know what I mean.
